# Sparkle: a small glowing octahedron (pollen burst), origin at its centre. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Pollen --base-color 1.0000 0.8549 0.2706 --emission 1.0000 0.8549 0.2706 --no-slot

material assign Pollen
shade flat
export sparkle.glb
